info.title: LMS API Documentation
info.description: API documentation for Learning Management System (LMS) Backend

get.summary: Get active schools for tenant login dropdown
get.description:
GET /api/{version}/schools/active
Return active schools for the login/register dropdowns in lms-fe.

post.description: Authenticate user with login code (student code, teacher code, username, or email) and password via Keycloak Direct Access Grant

200.description: Login successful with JWT access token

post.description: Register a new student/user in Keycloak and PostgreSQL database

POST /api/{version}/auth/refresh
Refresh Keycloak access token using refresh_token.

get.description:
GET /api/{version}/auth/me
Return current authenticated user profile from Keycloak JWT + PostgreSQL.

post.description:
POST /api/{version}/auth/2fa/setup
Provide QR code setup URI for 2FA modal compatibility in AdminLogin / SaaSAdminLogin.

200.description: QR code setup URI generated successfully
Whether the 6-digit verification code is valid

get.summary: Check application, database, and cache health

503.description: One or more critical dependencies are unhealthy

post.summary: Generate a temporary presigned PUT URL for uploading a file directly to Cloudflare R2
Confirm a direct R2 upload, verify magic bytes, and mark the image_uploads record as UPLOADED

409.description: Object not yet uploaded to R2

get.summary: Generate a temporary presigned GET URL to view or download a confirmed file from Cloudflare R2

409.description: File is not yet confirmed as UPLOADED

delete.summary: Delete a file from Cloudflare R2 and remove its image_uploads record

get.description: Retrieve the full academic and personal profile of the currently authenticated student

put.summary: Update authenticated student personal contact information
put.description: Update editable personal contact fields (email, phone, gender, address) for the authenticated student

422.description: Validation error or duplicate email within school
